1.title: All Math and Physics Mysteries Will Fall Soon | Joshua Achiam
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Joshua Achiam (ex-OpenAI Chief Futurist) discusses Anthropic's Riemann hypothesis breakthrough, superintelligence timelines and compute costs, Trump-Xi AI guardrails, AI-driven cyberattack risks, and US chip export controls on China.

1.title: Hackers Don’t Need New Exploits to Win With AI | Horizon3 CTO
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Horizon3 CTO explains how AI-enabled attackers are industrializing exploitation of *existing* vulnerabilities rather than developing new exploits; discusses autonomous offensive security, cyber debt, and why enterprises face bigger near-term risk than consumers.
